hero.caption: I carefully backtracked a walk I made in this area in 2014 and concluded my GPS data are correct. This implied that the data I found were used in the Wikidata Infobox, placing it in Beşiktaş were wrong. I think the reason is that a church with the alternative name Surp Asdvadzadzin indeed is in Beşiktaş. But it is not this one. I use the name I found on Google Maps, I think Asvazoni is another way of writing Asdvadzadzin.
